source_fact_patterns: Into the Breach presents enemy actions before resolution and makes consequences inspectable.
Frozen Synapse separates planning/preview from commit/resolve.
Godot Control/Container and multiple-resolution guidance support layout rules rather than baked UI text in background art.
Android accessibility guidance uses 48dp as a minimum interactive touch-target reference.
Historical ink painting references demonstrate negative space, value grouping, brush economy, and mist/wash separation useful for duel-distance readability.
benchmark_summary.project_recommendation: Use an ink-wash tactical art layer for gameplay with crisp editable UI above it; reserve denser cinematic color for key art only. Borrow intent/readability patterns, not deck/hand semantics, exact UI layouts, named-artist styles, or foreign game rules.

pillars: 거리의 긴장: negative space keeps duel distance readable
먹선으로 읽는 무공: pose/weapon/brush direction before decoration
종이 위의 전술: martial-manual/seal texture under crisp digital information
절제된 색의 의미: ink/off-white/brown base with restrained cinnabar/gold accents, never color-only
정본 텍스트는 editable UI layer: generated text is never authoritative
